title: DynaNDE: Dynamic Near-Data Expert Scheduling for Batched MoE Inference
abstract: arXiv:2609.00407v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable efficient scaling of large language model (LLM) inference but suffer from substantial data-movement overhead when deployed on neural processing unit (NPU)-based systems. Near-Data Processing (NDP) provides a promising way to mitigate this bottleneck via cooperative NPU-NDP execution. However, existing NPU-NDP MoE systems do not fully account for hardware heterogeneity, dynamic expert-level concurrency, and temporal expert reuse during batched inference. This paper presents DynaNDE, a dynamic near-data expert scheduling framework that exploits NPU-NDP collaboration to accelerate batched MoE inference. DynaNDE introduces an analytical performance model that captures hardware heterogeneity, data-movement costs, and communication-computation overlap in cooperative NPU-NDP execution. translated_title: DynaNDE：面向批处理MoE推理的动态近数据专家调度
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型能够实现大语言模型推理的高效扩展，但在部署于基于神经处理单元（NPU）的系统时会带来大量的数据移动开销。近数据处理（NDP）通过NPU-NDP协同执行为缓解这一瓶颈提供了一条有前景的途径。然而，现有的NPU-NDP MoE系统并未充分考虑硬件异构性、动态的专家级并发性以及批处理推理过程中的时间维度专家复用。本文提出了DynaNDE，一个利用NPU-NDP协同来加速批处理MoE推理的动态近数据专家调度框架。DynaNDE引入了一个分析性能模型，该模型刻画了协同NPU-NDP执行中的硬件异构性、数据移动成本以及通信与计算的重叠。在该模型的指导下，DynaNDE在兼顾专家（原文在此处截断）的情况下，确定跨NPU与NDP的逐层专家调度。
tldr: DynaNDE提出了一个动态近数据专家调度框架，通过分析性能模型捕捉硬件异构性与数据移动成本，在NPU与近数据处理单元之间进行逐层专家协同调度，从而加速批处理MoE推理。
en_tdlr: DynaNDE is a dynamic near-data expert scheduling framework that uses an analytical performance model capturing hardware heterogeneity and data-movement costs to coordinate per-layer expert scheduling between NPU and near-data processing, accelerating batched MoE inference.
